blocks.raw: Coupon represents store promotions or discounts created through Capillary Campaign Manager. A single campaign could contain one or more coupons or coupon series. Coupons are issued to loyalty or non-loyalty customers through SMS or email.
blocks.text: Coupon represents store promotions or discounts created through Capillary Campaign Manager. A single campaign could contain one or more coupons or coupon series. Coupons are issued to loyalty or non-loyalty customers through SMS or email.

blocks.raw: You cannot create new coupons using coupon APIs. You can just send or retrieve coupons that are already created in your campaigns. Hence, it is important to note the coupon code, coupon id or coupon series id for making API calls.

blocks.raw: A coupon series may have a fixed number of coupons, especially when coupons are manually uploaded. Once all coupons in the series have been issued, no further redemptions are possible for that series. Any attempt to redeem a coupon after the series limit is reached will fail. This ensures that the total number of redemptions does not exceed the configured limit for the coupon series.
blocks.text: A coupon series may have a fixed number of coupons, especially when coupons are manually uploaded. Once all coupons in the series have been issued, no further redemptions are possible for that series. Any attempt to redeem a coupon after the series limit is reached will fail. This ensures that the total number of redemptions does not exceed the configured limit for the coupon series.

blocks.raw: **Note:** Always ensure that the coupon series has sufficient unused coupons available before attempting redemption operations.
blocks.text: Note: Always ensure that the coupon series has sufficient unused coupons available before attempting redemption operations.
